title: Regime-gated hedged Binance funding carry: fcarry floor rule held only while market-wide funding is above the floor
drafted_by: ai:claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-24 (draft; user asked for it 2026-10-24 "ja" to D2 in research/drafts/DISCOVERY_2026-10-24_UDKAST.md)

disclosed: 2026-10-24: the idea came from reading fcarry's recorded results: E_fcarry__floor_a8 train3 +0.23 % (Sharpe 0.58, fails 2x costs), validation3 +2.2 % (Sharpe 7.3); E_fcarry__hyst_a8 train3 +0.03 % on 0.35 % exposure, validation3 +1.2 %. Train3 and validation3 screening of this family is therefore NOT unbiased; only the forward window can decide (research/studies/ANALYSE_2026-10-24.md section 2).
2026-10-24 market state seen: median Binance funding at the 0.01 %/8h floor, ~5 % of coins above it (/api/lanes market).
The 2026-10-18 aggregate funding-distribution read disclosed in fcarry.json applies here too.

mechanism.return_source: settled Binance USD-M funding received by the short perp leg
mechanism.non_price_prediction: Both legs are the same coin, so the price delta is ~0. P&L = funding received + change of the spot/perp ratio - costs. Signals forecast only the persistence of the funding cash flow, never price direction or relative price between coins. The extra signal (median funding across the universe) forecasts only whether the cash flow is worth its costs this week, never price direction.

attribution.rule: funding_income - (fees + spread + slippage) > 0 AND gross_ratio_pnl <= funding_income; in-sample (validation) and forward

evidence.ref: Binance USD-M funding = premium + clamp(0.01%/8h - premium, +-0.05%)
research/RESULTS_carry_v1.md: Hyperliquid carry, holdout +4.352 %, development -0.079 %, edge decaying
Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, BIS Working Paper 1087, Crypto carry

graveyard_acknowledged.materially_different_because: materially different because carry_v1 ran on Hyperliquid spot pairs (19 pairs, valid only from 2024-12, survivorship on delisted spot pairs, 2.2 coins on average) with weekly top-5 re-ranking whose fees exceeded the funding in development; this family uses Binance spot/perp pairs of the 30 PROTOCOL v3 coins with point-in-time data from 2022, low-turnover filter/hysteresis/persistence rules decided at 01:00 UTC, explicit two-leg costs, an attribution gate, and is decided only by an unseen 12-month forward window

materially different because L08 was unhedged leveraged perp carry that failed through liquidations at 5x-10x; this family is 1x, same-coin hedged, never leveraged, and rejects profit from price moves by the attribution gate

materially different because funding_contrarian was a directional tail-entry bet on 8 coins that lost to the 2023-H2 rally; this family has zero price delta per coin and is paid the funding instead of betting on a reversal

materially different because L22 traded minute-level premium convergence and lost 31.6-33.4 bp net to costs; this family holds for days to weeks, earns settled funding rather than premium reversion, and needs about 15 days of floor funding to repay a pair round trip

materially different because the floor rule here is held only while the market-wide median of 7-day funding is above a fixed gate (0.0004 or 0.0005 per day), so the position is flat in floor-funding regimes where E_fcarry__floor_a8 paid costs for almost no income (train3); it is the same cash flow and positively correlated, which the family file states
lessons_addressed: fcarry train3 costs in low-funding regimes

graveyard_acknowledged.materially_different_because: materially different because hyst decides per coin daily on APR_7 with hysteresis; this rule decides weekly with a market-wide gate
lessons_addressed: one regime bet, not independent members

graveyard_acknowledged.materially_different_because: materially different because filt churned daily per coin and lost to costs; this rule is weekly and gated market-wide
materially different because filt_w gated on the coin's own APR_7 only; this rule adds the market-wide gate

universe.rule: UNIVERSE_30_V3 (lab/engine/data.py:30-31); a coin whose spot or perp leg fails the existing data-quality rule in a split is excluded in that split (missing spot months fail coverage)
universe.forward_listing_rule: exclude a coin with no spot or perp file for the first window month (amendment 7 section 5)

instrument_model.bars: per coin and hour: (ts, spot_open / perp_open, spot_close / perp_close) on the intersection of hours
instrument_model.funding_for_costs: minus the settled rate, so a +1 position earns the settled rate through backtest.apply_costs
instrument_model.position: +1 = long 1 unit spot and short 1 unit perp, equal notional, 1x; 0 = flat; never negative
instrument_model.benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same USD-M perps with catalogue costs and funding

costs.funding: settled Binance funding from the data, credited to the short perp leg

windows.holdout: 2024, sealed, human approval only, without BTC/ETH/SOL
windows.reserved: 2025-01-01 until the forward window start, never read

instances.rule: Mondays 01:00 UTC. gate = median over coins with 7 days of history of (funding settled in the 7 days before the decision / 7); open iff gate >= gate_day. Hold +1 for the week iff the gate is open and the coin's floor share (fraction of the last 14 completed UTC days with summed settled funding >= 0.0003) >= 0.8.

expected.p_at_least_one_forward_pass: lower than fcarry's 0.04-0.12 while funding stays at the floor [estimate]
expected.correlation_with_fcarry: high (same cash flow, same coins); a joint PASS of fcarry and fregime is not two independent findings
